## History

Irving was a former fiancé of Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) who had a son named [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) from a prior relationship. After [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md) formed a bond with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md), Irving reunited with her and the two were eventually married in the garden at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge) surrounded by friends. Following the ceremony, he and his new bride were seen off by their wedding party at [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station.

_Sources: [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P0](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0000), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P1](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0001), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P2](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0002), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P6](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0006), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P7](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0007), [v2 XXIII Miss Lavendar’s Romance P8](../source/v02-c23.md#nw-v02-c23-p0008), +42 more_

## Relationships

### [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/irving--lavendar-lewis.md)

Irving and Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) were previously engaged, but a past rift separated them for years until they eventually reunited as lovers. Their connection is rekindled through Irving's son, [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md), leading to their marriage in a garden ceremony at [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge). Following their wedding, the couple departs together from [Bright River](../codex/places.md#bright-river) station to begin their married life.

- Romantically involved with — former lovers/reuniting suitors  <sub>[v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P45](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0045), [v2 XXVIII The Prince Comes Back to the Enchanted Palace P70](../source/v02-c28.md#nw-v02-c28-p0070), [v2 XXX A Wedding at the Stone House P12](../source/v02-c30.md#nw-v02-c30-p0012)</sub>
